description: Scala source code defining the OrderedFilters class, which compiles and applies data filters for Spark SQL's internal row processing, including filter grouping, predicate creation, and row skipping logic.

classes.name: OrderedFilters
classes.description: A class that compiles filters into predicates and sorts them for efficient application to partially initialized internal rows in Spark SQL.

methods.name: skipRow
methods.description: Determines whether to skip a row based on applied filters up to a specified index.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal filter states; trivial in this implementation as filters have no state.
